import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv', 
                   parse_dates=['date'], 
                   infer_datetime_format=True)

# Convert 'is_takeaway' column to category
data['is_takeaway'] = data['is_takeaway'].astype('category')

# Pivot the data to create a bar chart of sales by product and takeaway status
sales_by_product = data.pivot_table(index='product', columns='is_takeaway', values='quantity', aggfunc='sum')

# Create a bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=sales_by_product.columns, y=sales_by_product[0], data=sales_by_product)
plt.title('Coffee Sales by Product and Takeaway Status')
plt.xlabel('Takeaway Status')
plt.ylabel('Quantity Sold')
plt.legend(title='Takeaway Status', loc='upper right')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
